paragraphs.source_en: It was June 22 of the first year of Genki when Tokugawa Ieyasu set out from Hamamatsu Castle for Ōmi, beneath a blazing midsummer sun that scorched the earth.

units.source_en: It was June 22 of the first year of Genki when Tokugawa Ieyasu set out from Hamamatsu Castle for Ōmi, beneath a blazing midsummer sun that scorched the earth.
units.source_zh: 德川家康从滨松城向近江进发时，正是元龟元年六月二十二，盛夏的烈日炙烤着大地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 德川家康从滨松城向近江进发时，正是元龟元年六月二十二，盛夏的烈日炙烤着大地。

paragraphs.source_en: On May 18, one month earlier, Ieyasu had returned to Okazaki. There he met his son Nobuyasu, then departed at dawn on the twenty-fourth. Some of the senior retainers were reluctant to take the field for Nobunaga again, but Ieyasu paid them no heed.

units.source_en: On May 18, one month earlier, Ieyasu had returned to Okazaki.
units.source_zh: 五月十八家康曾经回过冈崎，那是一个月前。

units.source_en: There he met his son Nobuyasu, then departed at dawn on the twenty-fourth.
units.source_zh: 他在那里见了儿子信康一面，于二十四清晨离去。

units.source_en: Some of the senior retainers were reluctant to take the field for Nobunaga again, but Ieyasu paid them no heed.
units.source_zh: 有的老臣不愿为信长再次出兵，但家康并不放在心上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 五月十八家康曾经回过冈崎，那是一个月前。他在那里见了儿子信康一面，于二十四清晨离去。有的老臣不愿为信长再次出兵，但家康并不放在心上。

paragraphs.source_en: Some believed Ieyasu was acting out of loyalty to Nobunaga. But he was not foolish enough to march to war for loyalty alone. Nor was he afraid of Nobunaga. Ultimately, this campaign was meant to display the passion of his youth and his foresight into the course the realm was taking.

paragraphs.source_en: Nobunaga had already shown Ieyasu the strength of the Oda clan. Ieyasu could hardly remain indifferent. If he did not want Nobunaga to look down on him, he had to display his own strength to the full. “As expected of Ieyasu—not only is his loyalty boundless, but his army is vast and his commanders formidable.” Only by winning Nobunaga’s recognition could he escape his mockery and contempt.

paragraphs.source_en: In that sense, this expedition to Ōmi possessed genuine meaning; if he hesitated now, his earlier campaign in Echizen would be seen as a weak man compelled by a strong one, rendering that expedition meaningless.

paragraphs.source_en: “Your father goes on this campaign to show the Oda our strength. So while Saburō remains here, you must devote yourself to governing well, win the wholehearted respect of our retainers, and make them praise you as no less capable than your father.” Only after leaving these words with Nobuyasu did Ieyasu ride out of the castle. All the while, he searched the gathering of well-wishers for the figure of Lady Sena.

paragraphs.source_en: Near the main gate, Ieyasu saw his mother, Lady Odai, and his stepmother, Lady Kakei-in. Twelve-year-old Princess Toku had come to see him off, accompanied by three maids. She had grown so much that she seemed another person. But his wife, Lady Sena, never appeared. Ieyasu gently shook his head in the saddle, then at once composed himself and prepared to ride to the battlefield.
